title: Rethinking Machine Ethics – Can LLMs Perform Moral Reasoning through the Lens of Moral Theories?
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not measure any aspects of religion or faith. The benchmark measures the ability of LLMs to perform moral reasoning and judgment through the lens of secular moral theories like Justice, Deontology, Utilitarianism, and the Theory of Dyadic Morality.
findings: The paper does not contain any findings related to religion, as its focus is on secular moral philosophy and psychology.
